text: {"lessons":["My account rose from $97,586 to $104,186 while I made no trades in most periods, so I should not trade just to feel active.","Selling some shares at a loss or a gain does not by itself show that the decision was sound; I should base trades on a clear plan, not just my average cost.","I should keep retirement needs and overall portfolio risk in view, and avoid letting any one stock or a short run of price moves drive my decisions."]}
